baseline.method: Complete official-author MATLAB measuredRF vector recipe with fixedS1e4 robustDCT-PLS; conditional method reference, not velocity truth

reference_type: Independently executed official-author conditional method estimate. No measured true disk speed or true velocity field is supplied.
nrmse_definition: sqrt(mean((estimate-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)), separately for every vx and vz value on the full public disk support.
support: All31404 pixels in public observation_roi; exterior must be zero. No fitted rotation, gain, alignment, permutation or unreported crop.
threshold_provenance: Frozen before local extraction: independent complete original repeat, original complex64-intermediate full pipeline, float32 serialization; five times worst measured NRMSE. NCC numerical floor20float64eps. Phase boundary1.1times original measured phasorRMS.
physics_metric: sqrt(sum(abs(AC)*abs(exp(-i*pi*predicted_radial/VN)-AC/abs(AC))^2)/sum(abs(AC))), both receive beams on all31404 publicdisk pixels. AC uses31 temporal pairs and11x11 replicate Hamming averaging.
